caption: The drawing features a single, tall, and ornate pitcher placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The object is rendered using shades of gray and black, giving it a metallic appearance. The pitcher has a rounded body that tapers at both the top and bottom, with a flared base that stands on a square platform. The upper section of the pitcher has a domed, hinged lid with a finial at the top and a decorative beaded edge. The spout is elongated and curves outward with a defined lip, while the handle is large, curved, and attached from the top of the pitcher near the lid to the widest part of the body, showing some shading for depth. The composition is void of any other objects or background details, focusing solely on the single pitcher.
title: Silver Hot Water Pot
